episodes.title: No one is going to accept again
episodes.description: There's a newcomer at school, Memo. The only ones who take pity on him are a group of knowledge traffickers who sell assignments and homework. The group is in the middle of a small crisis. Alex and Marifer, who've been dating for a while, are going through a difficult time. She wants to have sex but he doesn't because he likes Rafa, a guy who works at his family's video store.

episodes.title: No one is going to get away with it
episodes.description: Alex hangs out with Rafa, and his relationship with Marifer wavers. At school, the bullies go after Memo, and Alex stops selling them “merchandise." Diego, extremely popular, makes sure no one buys homework from them. Memo and Tenoch intervene, but Diego warns them that Alex will replace them. Alex talks to Memo about his crush on Rafa. Alex is about to kiss Rafa, but Marifer interrupts.

episodes.title: No one did the English homework
episodes.description: Ilse, the English teacher, wants the class to write about their childhood. Marifer and Memo are in charge of the homework papers, but Marifer is only focused on Alex and Rafa. Memo convinces Alex to be honest, and Marifer breaks up with him. Marifer and Memo turn in the assignments, but Ilse suspects they're all too similar. Memo tells Marifer about his dark side, who admits she has one too.

episodes.title: No one is going to Mariana's party
episodes.description: The gang goes to a party. Marifer gets drunk and flirts with Lalo, a skateboarder. Alex avoids his snobbish ex-friends. Daniela sees Diego with his girlfriend, and Tenoch realizes there's something between them. Only Memo has fun drinking. Susana, Alex's sister, kisses Tenoch. Everything ends with Marifer fighting with Alex, revealing to everyone that he likes Rafa. Alex feels abashed.

episodes.title: No one is going to talk about what happened at the party
episodes.description: The school wonders if Alex is gay. Marifer is treated as the resentful girlfriend, so she flees to Lalo. Tenoch wants Daniela to choose between Diego and the business. Thanks to Memo, Daniela also makes Diego choose between her or Mariana. Diego and Daniela have sex. Thinking Diego chose her, Daniela leaves the business reluctantly. Her sister consoles her, encouraging her to be independent.

episodes.title: No one is going to sing at the karaoke
episodes.description: The only ones left in the business are Tenoch and Memo. Daniela is their new competition. Also, teacher Ilse wants them to stop. Tenoch decides to retire after pulling off an exam heist. Diego annoys Tenoch by saying he's gay, too, so Tenoch mocks Alex in front of others to come out unscathed. Meanwhile, Alex confesses to Rafa that he likes him, but Rafa only wants to be friends.

episodes.title: No one is going to be able to stand against the dark side
episodes.description: Memo learns he will move to the USA. He invites Alex, Tenoch, Marifer, and Daniela to his house. The relationship between everyone is tense, but Memo brings out his karaoke machine, and they start having a good time. Memo thanks Alex for getting him into their group. Alex heads home, but he remains uneasy. When he returns to see Memo, he sees an ambulance. Memo wanted to say goodbye to them.

episodes.title: No one is going to miss us
episodes.description: Memo killed himself. Alex breaks down at school. Everyone says they feel bad for Memo, but no one will miss him. The dreaded exam arrives, but the answers Tenoch sold are not useful. He's about to get beaten up. The band intervenes. Reflecting on Memo unites them. They consider restarting the business and encourage Alex to talk to Rafa. They kiss. The ending is happy but uncertain.

episodes.title: No One Is Thinking About the Future
episodes.description: It's the first day of senior year, and the Super Friends are dealing with Memo's death and the physics exam disaster. They need to win back their clients if they want the business to survive, but they will soon face a threat they never even imagined.

episodes.title: No One Told Us We'd Have Competition
episodes.description: Diego confronts his new situation and realizes he misses an old friend. The band also faces a change in their school status when, for the first time, they face competition.

episodes.title: No One Knows What They're Going To Be When They Grow Up
episodes.description: While Tenoch tries to bring a new element into the business, Alex attempts to break into Rafa's world where he discovers he has unexpected competition.

episodes.title: No One Can Skip the Club
episodes.description: In an effort to win over members of the rival group, Tenoch takes everyone to their first school party at News. There, everyone's secrets are revealed, and Tenoch realizes that Ricardo is a much tougher rival than he first thought.

episodes.title: No One Expected the Crisis
episodes.description: The 1994 economic crisis, known as the "December Mistake," affects the lives of all Mexicans. And the super friends' own December mistake-going to News-also comes back to haunt them. Broken hearts are everywhere, but at least Marifer finally knows what she wants to be when she grows up.

episodes.title: No One Wants to Be a Responsable Adult
episodes.description: An unexpected emergency brings Daniela and Mariana together for the first time. Daniela must deal with the consequences of her relationship with Diego and decide whether she is the heroine or the villain of the telenovela.

episodes.title: No One Knows Who They Really Are
episodes.description: It's the senior class trip for Heroes of the Revolution High School. It will be a night of encounters and broken hearts that no one saw coming. As for Tenoch, he must face the fact that maybe he's no longer the same person he once was.

episodes.title: We're All Going to Miss Each Other
episodes.description: The group graduates, and as they figure out what they'll do after high school, they face changes in the competition and a threat to their favorite teacher. But the scariest question after graduation is, will they still be friends?
